business: Le Shish Taouk — 9105-E, boulevard Taschereau, Brossard (Québec) J4Y 3B8 — (450) 724-9999
builtBy: operator, by hand (2026-10-19), for Dory's account (dory@liasse.tech)
primaryAction: Order for pickup on command.restaurant: https://order.command.restaurant/b/le-shish-taouk-bross/order (admin setting order_url overrides it)

pages./: Hero (title, lead, order + menu buttons, Google rating, plate photo), « Composez votre bol » 4 steps, « Les incontournables » (feed dishes that have a photo, drinks excluded), menu sections grid, « Nous trouver » (address, phone, hours when set, directions), order band
pages./menu: The full command.restaurant menu: sticky section bar, every dish with photo, both-language name, description, required choices and price (« à partir de » when a required choice costs more), order dock on phones
pages./admin: Owner settings (phone, address, maps link, hours FR/EN, rating display, order link) + pointer to Command.Restaurant for the menu

menuSource.how: lib/menu.js — fetched server-side, cached 10 min, last good copy kept, lib/menu-fallback.js snapshot (2026-10-19) until the first good read. Names/descriptions/categories are « FR / EN » pairs split by language. The volatile `available` flag is ignored (ordering enforces it). Never copy dishes into this site's database: the restaurant edits its menu in Command.Restaurant only.

design.concept: La broche — the logo's stacked amber bands on a skewer are the single motif (hero, footer, eyebrows, section accents)

editing: Every static string carries data-lk="t:<key>" (strings in lib/i18n.js); logo/hero/phone/address/rating carry data-setting-key. Menu content is not editable here by design.
gaps: Opening hours unknown: command.restaurant has a 24/7 placeholder and Uber Eats shows only its delivery window (11:00–20:43 Sun–Wed, 11:00–21:43 Thu–Sat). The Hours block stays hidden until the owner fills hours_fr / hours_en in /admin.
Google rating (4.8, 1 356 reviews) is the 2026-10-19 figure synced by command.restaurant; it is static here. The owner can update or hide it in /admin.
Menu prices were imported from the Uber Eats pickup menu and may be higher than in-store prices; confirm with the restaurant (change them in Command.Restaurant).
Pitas have no topping or sauce options on Uber Eats, so none are listed.
Logo is a 400 px JPEG on a white ground (no vector or transparent version on file).
